coverage: 33 snapshot day(s) on record across SPY, QQQ and IWM; the most recent snapshot day is 2026-11-13. Each snapshot shows the contracts on record for that day only; a contract missing from a snapshot is not shown, never filled in from another day
delay: Each snapshot is as it stood when the chain was read that day; a figure the snapshot does not carry is shown as not on record, never filled in from another day or another source. Nothing here is live

explanation.body: Its current reading is from 2026-11-13. No study record is on file for this page; what it shows is its current reading, updated on its normal schedule.
explanation.summary: Show a full options chain as it was recorded on a past trading day: every strike for the expiry you pick, with each call and put's open interest, volume and priced-in volatility, and greeks this page computes from those recorded figures.

greeks_note: The greeks on this page are computed by this page, in your browser, from the recorded price level and the recorded implied volatility, using the same pricing model as the Payoff Sketch on this site (the standard textbook formula, a 4.5% interest rate, no dividends, time to expiry counted from the end of the snapshot day). They are labelled computed because the recorded chain carries no greeks of its own
